title: Payments and billing
html:
Fitzgerald Enterprises LLC charges in US dollars and accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover.

Amount and timing

Before payment you see the item subtotal, discounts, shipping, applicable sales tax and total due today. We request authorisation when you submit the order and collect payment when the order is accepted. An authorisation can temporarily reduce your available balance before a payment posts.

Recognising your purchase

A charge appears on your statement as FERN WORK. Compare it with the amount and date on your receipt. If you see two entries, check whether one is still pending. For two posted charges, email PumpCadle668@outlook.com with the amounts, dates and order number; we will trace them and correct a duplicate capture. For a charge you believe was unauthorised, contact your issuer as well.

Failed payments and credits

If a payment fails, check for an order confirmation before retrying. If you have a confirmation, ask us to verify the order status. Merchandise credits are explained in Returns, refunds and order cancellations.

Checkout security

Start checkout from fernwork.zeabur.app. The payment page is our payment processor's hosted checkout. Our team sees only the last four digits, the card brand and the outcome. Our support team will never ask you to read out a one-time banking code, disclose a password or email a card security code.
